The must-sees

  • Dune 7

    Viewpoint

    Walkers and sandboarders climb its steep ridge for views over the desert and the bay. From the top, the town and the Atlantic lie spread out below.

    Look for: On a windy day, watch the crest: sand streams off the sharp ridge like smoke as the wind slowly moves the dune.

  • Pelican Point

    Waterfront

    Thousands of Cape fur seals haul out at the tip. The spit shelters the bay, the best natural harbour on the coast.

  • Rhenish Mission Church

    Church · 1880

    It was made in Hamburg, shipped in parts, and put up in 1880. It is now a national monument.

  • Walvis Bay Lagoon

    Waterfront

    Thousands of greater and lesser flamingos feed here, along with pelicans and waders. The lagoon has been a Ramsar wetland of international importance since 1995.

    Look for: Tell the two flamingos apart: lesser flamingos are smaller and deeper pink with dark bills; greater flamingos are taller and paler, with a pink bill tipped black.

How it works

  1. Open Wizzy in Walvis Bay and tap Start walk, or pick a ready-made walk.
  2. Put your phone in your pocket. Wizzy runs in the background, even with the screen locked.
  3. When you pass a place, you get a ping. Open it for the story, or keep walking.

Every place you see gets stamped in your Walvis Bay passport. Your location stays on your phone. No ads, no tracking.
